matchmaking_summary: Robert R. Jordan is a highly skilled and experienced IT executive with over a decade of leadership in the technology sector, specializing in enterprise-level infrastructure management for retail environments. His career has been marked by accomplishments such as successfully migrating from Microsoft Server 2003 to 2012, implementing VMware Horizon View, managing large-scale virtual environments, and overseeing help desks using ITIL standards. With a strong background in project management, including conversions of dealership management systems (DMS) and the implementation of digital storage processes that led to significant operational efficiency gains, Robert is well-versed in strategic technology deployment for organizations seeking to enhance their professional operations while ensuring robust security controls over vast amounts of customer data.
